llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed dLazy/Nano Banana 2 image-generation wrapper, with expected cloud API use and local API-key storage but no artifact-backed malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: Network access to api.dlazy.com and files.dlazy.com, plus reading only user-supplied media paths for upload, is proportionate for a hosted image-generation service and is disclosed in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill installs or runs a pinned external npm CLI package, @dlazy/cli@1.2.3, with source and npm package links disclosed; the package contents were not present in the artifact for local code review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger keywords include generic image-generation phrases, which could cause broader activation than the product-specific phrases, but the resulting behavior is still aligned with image generation and is documented.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Authentication persists an API key in ~/.dlazy/config.json unless the user supplies DLAZY_API_KEY per invocation; this credential storage is clearly disclosed and revocation/rotation is described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to generate or edit images using Nano Banana 2.0, and the documented capability matches that purpose: prompts and selected media inputs are sent to dLazy endpoints and generated image URLs are returned.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that prompts and any image, video, or audio paths you provide may be uploaded to dLazy's cloud service, and that login stores an API key locally unless you use the DLAZY_API_KEY environment variable. Review the pinned CLI package/source if you need assurance about the external npm code.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced Chinese skill file was present in the workspace and inspected, so the partial-inspection concern is resolved for this adjudication.
[SQP-3] expected: The package provides both English and Chinese skill files; the Chinese file being in Chinese is not evidence of malicious or hidden behavior, though clearer language-selection guidance would improve usability.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad image-generation triggers are real and could cause over-activation, but they point to the same disclosed image-generation workflow rather than unrelated or covert behavior.
[P9] unexpected: The long whitespace occurs in markdown table alignment in the error-handling section; full file inspection found no hidden instructions after the padding.
